```python
def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    header = '   REMEDIATIONS'
    footer = '+' + '=' * (columns - 2) + '+'
    
    if not is_using_api_key():
        total_vulns = sum(
            data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            for pkg_data in remediations.values()
            for data in pkg_data.values()
        )
        total_pkgs = len(remediations)
        vuln_word = 'vulnerability' if total_vulns == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
        pkg_word = 'package' if total_pkgs == 1 else 'packages'
        msg = f'{total_vulns} {vuln_word} was reported in {total_pkgs} {pkg_word}. For detailed remediation & fix recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license.'
        content = format_long_text(msg, columns=columns, start_line_decorator='  ', end_line_decorator=' ')
        return [header, '\n' + content + '\n', footer]
    
    content_parts = []
    for pkg_name, versions in remediations.items():
        for version_spec, data in versions.items():
            vulns_found = data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            version = data.get('version', version_spec.lstrip('='))
            recommended = data.get('recommended_version', None)
            closest = data.get('closest_secure_version', {})
            other_recommended = data.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
            more_info_url = data.get('more_info_url', '')
            
            closest_upper = closest.get('upper', None) or closest.get('major', None)
            
            vuln_word = 'vulnerability' if vulns_found == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
            
            block = f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} {vuln_word}\n'
            
            if closest_upper:
                block += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {closest_upper}\n'
            
            block += ' ' * (columns - 2) + '\n'
            
            if recommended:
                rec_line = f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended} of {pkg_name}.'
                if other_recommended:
                    other_str = ', '.join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)
                    rec_line += f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_str}'
                block += rec_line + '\n'
            
            block += ' ' * (columns - 2) + '\n'
            
            if more_info_url:
                block += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                block += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                block += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'
            
            block += ' ' * (columns - 2)
            
            content_parts.append(block)
    
    content = ''.join(content_parts)
    return [header, content, footer]
```
